title: Deebo Samuel makes NFL history with 0 catches for 80 receiving yards and 1 TD

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deebo Samuel makes NFL history with 0 catches for 80 receiving yards and 1 TD
sources.description: San Francisco wide receiver Deebo Samuel had a stat line never before seen in NFL history today: Zero catches, 80 receiving yards and a receiving touchdown.
